title: Netac Shadow II DDR4 32GB (2x16GB) 3200MHz CL16 RAM US$131.75 (~A$188.65) Delivered @ Netac Official Store AliExpress
body:
Deal: Netac Shadow II DDR4 32GB (2x16GB) 3200MHz CL16 RAM US$131.75 (~A$188.65) Delivered @ Netac Official Store AliExpress

[Clear] On the topic of DDR5, there's this listing for a single stick of 32GB 5600MHz CL46 for US$294.88 (~A$422.22) with codes CWAU23 and MEMORY1
I'm not entirely sure if that's a good deal or not?
[davidl222222] waiting for Topcashback UK & AU to act… :)
[DraggyX] Funny it tracked the cheap items but the expensive ones in my order last time ( yes I checked the affiliated items before place the order)
[VoidIvory] Can't seem to get NETACDDR44 to work? Says "Sorry, this code can't be applied. It may be incorrect, inactive, or already used."
[Clear] Clicking on the coupon banner underneath the price it's visible for me.
[NoBalls] I can't see it on the banner either and doesnt let me apply at checkout. Maybe targeted
[Clear] That would appear to be the case, as the mods were able to see it.
[yak] Mark me as another one who can't see that particular discount code in the dropdown. I tried using it anyway, and got the expected error. Thanks for the promo tho! I appreciate the effort.
[Knightchampion] Thanks. No idea how you found out about the deal. The coupon code doesn't show on their store page like last time. Paid a total of $180 for this deal with an additional $8.32 tracked for topcashback.
[radradrobotank] DM me if you are interested in an as new Patriot Viper Elite II 64GB DDR4 kit I recently received from an RMA. I'll sell it for cheaper than this deal.
